purpose: Fresh-seed four-PEMS confirmation of the full-coverage four-token MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate.
research_question: Across PEMS03/04/07/08 at H12, can patch_len=24, stride=24 retain the local accuracy and latency signal while separating architecture and AutoCon effects?
selection_history: The architecture was frozen after a resource preflight and a three-seed PEMS07 probe: patch_len=24, patch_stride=24, d_model=16, d_ff=32, d_state=8, d_conv=2, expand=1. Seeds 2101/2102/2103 are fresh for this confirmation.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory confirmation. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A favorable result supports a separately authorized test-release design only; it does not establish all-horizon or general time-series superiority.
prelaunch_gates: verify four PEMS hashes and train-only normalization contract
freeze full-coverage p24/s24 candidate and exact lambda-zero graph
pair active/null on every dataset-seed coordinate
use the fixed post-freeze resource protocol

phases.name: pems_h12_fullcover_p24_s24_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact full-coverage AutoCon-capable graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: pems_h12_fullcover_p24_s24_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact full-coverage AutoCon-capable graph with lambda 0.001.

primary_contrasts: candidate versus frozen same-source baseline means
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Measure the candidate and TimeMixer on each PEMS shape with the fixed prediction-only GPU protocol.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, long-horizon, graph-aware, or general time-series claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
If active exceeds the best frozen external baseline by more than 1% on any dataset mean, do not promote the candidate to test release.
If active/null is not directionally reproducible, do not claim causal AutoCon accuracy benefit.
Do not release test metrics from this confirmation.
